productName: Lorena Canals Woolable Sheep of the World Tundra Washable Area Rug
description:
Enjoy the natural colors and soft textures of undyed wool through our Sheep of the World collection. This clean, plain-colored design in a beautiful long pile is a staple piece suited to any decor, adding that special touch of elegance and coziness that brings the room together.

The Tundra rug is made in a soft 2 cm long wool pile, interrupted by rows of longer piles crossing over. Available in blended yarns of Sheep White + Sheep Beige, achieving light elegant color shades.

- This rug is machine washable! Lorena Canals' patented Woolable technology makes this innovative series possible - pure wool pile is backed with flexible cotton canvas, making each rug strong and flexible enough to be washed right at home.
- Skilled artisans craft every Sheep of the World area rug by hand using 100% wool rug yarns over a flexible recycled cotton backing. Each one includes a convenient printed tote bag for storage and a complimentary nonslip underlay for stability.
- Lightweight: flexible design that makes the rug easily machine washable without sacrificing quality.
- Long Lasting: high-quality natural fibers to ensure maximum durability.
- Lorena Canals supports weaving communities through solidarity programs like the Sakula Project.
- Wash on a gentle cycle using cool water and mild detergent. Tumble dry on low heat.
